name: Anime Vanguards
creator: Kitawari
redeem: Launch Anime Vanguards on Roblox and wait until you load into the lobby.
Press the Profile button on the right side of the screen.
Click the purple Codes button on the left side of the Profile menu.
Type the code in the Enter code box, matching capital letters, and hit Redeem Code.
notes:
Anime Vanguards is a tower defense game from Kitawari. You summon units based on anime characters, place them along the enemy path, and upgrade them during the match to stop waves of enemies and bosses. Between matches you level up and evolve your units, then take them into story stages, raids, challenges and events, either solo or with friends.

Codes in this game mostly give Trait Rerolls, Memoria Shards and Gems. Trait Rerolls are the most useful reward, since a strong trait on your main damage unit makes a big difference in harder stages. New codes usually come out with each update, often along with apology codes when an update is delayed, and they are posted in the Discord announcements channel. Most codes only last until the next update, so redeem them quickly.

codes.reward: 100 Trait Rerolls, 100 Memoria Shards and 5,000 Gems (level 30 needed)

faq.q: Why does AnniNextHopefully say I cannot use it?
faq.a: That code needs you to be level 30. Keep playing story stages to level up, then come back and try it again.

faq.q: What should I spend my Trait Rerolls on?
faq.a: Put them into your strongest damage unit instead of spreading them across your whole team. One unit with a great trait helps more than several units with average ones.
Code sites report it ends around October 2, 2026. Anime Vanguards codes are often removed after the next update, so it is best to redeem new ones on the day they come out.

tips: Place units where the enemy path bends or loops. Enemies stay in range for longer there, so each unit deals more damage.
Upgrade a few good units during a match instead of filling the map with weak ones. An upgraded damage unit usually handles waves and bosses better than several cheap ones.
Replay story stages you have already cleared to gain levels for you and your units before you try harder stages.
Pick one main unit to evolve first instead of splitting materials across your whole team. Bring friends for raids and challenges, since more units on the map makes tough waves easier.
useRewards: Gems pay for summons, so keep the 5,000 from AnniNextHopefully until a banner has a unit you actually want. Trait Rerolls and Memoria Shards are best spent on the units you use most in harder stages. Redeem every code as soon as you meet its level requirement, because older codes like Wrath, Retribution and MiniUpd2 have already been removed.
codeChannels: The Anime Vanguards Discord #announcements channel, the game's X account and the Kitawari Roblox group
requirement: Codes need at least level 10, and some need level 30.
